enchantments.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus: +3 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Transmuted Platinum: This weapon, made of transmuted platinum, is slightly magically unstable, and has a chance to transfer its magic to those it strikes. Struck enemies have a small chance to turn into transmuted platinum, preventing all movement, with a DC of 35 negating this effect.
Bludgeoning 2: The edges of this weapon are blunted, dealing an additional 2d6 bludgeon damage on each hit.
Metalline: Metalline bypasses any metal based damage reduction. (Adamantine, "Alchemical, Silver", Byeshk, Cold Iron, Mithral)
Smashing 5: The edges of this weapon are blunted, dealing an additional 5d6 bludgeoning damage on each critical hit.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
